name: Toy Army ⚔️
description:
GREEN vs TAN! Open bags of toy soldiers, merge them into tanks and helicopters, and capture the bedroom! ⚔️

🎒 Open soldier bags and merge 3 of a kind
🚩 Deploy your squad to capture flags
🐱 Watch out for the CAT: it swats both armies!
🐶 Call in rubber bands, rockets and THE DOG on the enemy
🏆 28 toys to collect, Gold, Glow and Rainbow mutations

🎁 CODE: LAUNCH for free plastic and soldier bags!
⏰ Hourly MEGA CAT event with 2x plastic

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for a new room every week!
